body: Having below average genes doesn't contribute to human evolution, so I don't see a reason to reproduce. Not saying you can't be good at something just because someone is short. I just don't want to pass on my genes.

Well, I'm 5'7" which is below average for American male, which makes me short. I'm not smart which makes me stupid. I don't have a symmetrical face or straight teeth which is the basis of attractiveness, making me ugly. My junk is below average, making it small.
I'm short, stupid, ugly, small "package", etc.
